title: VSift transcript.get JSON Lines terminal data v1
description: The data member of the complete terminal result that ends a transcript.get --events jsonl stream. It is the page of transcript-get-data.schema.json without its items: the page's segments were the preceding evidence events, in start order, and record_count says how many there were. Pass next_cursor back with the same session and range to stream the next page; null means the range is exhausted.
